sub_palette: celtic (goidelic) backbone + classical (hellenic) overlay (cross-family blend, Celtic-leaning)

blend.backbone: celtic (goidelic register: ri/tuath/dun/rath, mac/ua patronymics, initial consonant mutation, broad-slender contrast, root-initial stress, the cland war-aristocracy and the sworn hosting)
blend.overlay: classical (hellenic: the polis and the agora, the archon civic register, pitch-accent learning, -os/-on/-polis toponyms, the philosophers and the fleets)
blend.lean: Celtic-heavy - a Goidelic warrior-aristocracy (the cland war-bands that crossed into the east and settled among the Greek cities) enthroned over the Hellenic city-civilization: the sworn cland holds the crown and the hosting, the learned poleis and their fleets endure and serve beneath.

_note: NEW cross-family hybrid under the base/hybrid model. BASE_02 (Celtic / Goidelic) x BASE_07 (Hellenic/Classical). CIV/CLAN DECIDED by inheritance: Celtic base = Clanhold, Greek/Classical base = Civilized, and any Civ parent -> Civ, so Ionbria is Civilized (feudal). Concept: a Goidelic Celtic warrior-aristocracy - the Galatians who crossed into the east as war-bands and settled near the Greek poleis of Anatolia and the Aegean - that made itself a ruling cland over the Hellenic city-civilization (a Celtic-Hellenistic fusion: a Celtic war-aristocracy over Greek poleis and their learned populace). Backbone = Celtic (GOIDELIC: the ruling cland and the sworn hosting, the ri/tuath/flaith register, mac/ua patronymics); overlay/substrate = Classical (HELLENIC: the polis and the agora, the archon civic register, the learned populace, the fleets, -os/-on/-polis toponyms). Common-word lexicon and rank titles use the real Gaelic and Greek registers (allowed, catalog 5.3); DEITY names are morphs of the Agrippan canon from both parents (Celtic Goidelic reflexes PRIMARY from family_celtic theonym_set, Hellenic variants SECONDARY following achillean's deity-morph register), never real Celtic/Greek gods. PROVISIONAL: alignment is a per-hybrid design choice pending the alignment pass - the Celtic war-oath and the cland's hosting meet the Hellenic civic law and the polis' settled order. Register choice: this Celtic-base hybrid uses the GOIDELIC reflexes (Galanpolis = the Gauls' city), per the Galatian rationale - flag for Jedidiah if the Brythonic register is wanted instead. [UPDATE 2026-06-27: all human cultures allow Lawful/Neutral/Chaotic (per-hybrid alignment restriction removed). Ruler/domain DISPLAY titles are now English (or an approved foreign term); conlang titles moved to ruler_native/domain_native for NPC dialogue. Deities unchanged: canonical Agrippan pantheon via the per-family morph method.]

phonology.palette: Celtic (Goidelic) backbone - root-initial stress, initial consonant mutation (lenition c>ch, b>bh/v, m>mh/v, t>th, d>dh; nasalization), the broad-slender consonant contrast, vowels a e i o u (long marks dropped in data), mac/ua patronymic prefixes - meeting a Hellenic overlay: vowel-rich a e i o u with long e/o, aspirates th/ph/kh, sibilant s, the civic -os/-on/-eus/-e endings and -polis. Per the CSV: a pitch accent set over lyrical, vowel-rich Goidelic sound (the Hellenic pitch lifting the Celtic vowels); grammar is VSO with complex aspects carried on the Celtic initial-mutation system (the verb-first Celtic frame over the Greek aspectual layer). Theophoric on the Celtic reflexes (Toran-, Orlann-) with Hellenic variants (Tulrio-, Orlandro-).
phonology.phonotactics: CV / CVC; mutation-driven Celtic clusters and the broad-slender contrast meeting Hellenic onset-clusters (kt, pt, ps, th, ph, kh) and the open vowel-final -os/-on; root-initial stress with a Hellenic penultimate pull; Goidelic Dun-/Rath-/Cill- names over -polis / -os / -eia civic toponyms.

sound_changes: Hellenic civic endings adapted to Goidelic: final -os>-as/-a, -on>-an, -e>-a, -eus>-each; the case-vowel drops or relenites onto a Goidelic stem (potamos>potam, thalassa>talas)
Hellenic pitch-accent yields to Goidelic root-initial stress on every word; the penultimate pull is lost
Greek aspirates and clusters fold into the Goidelic inventory: ph>f, kh>c/ch, ps>s, initial pt-/kt- simplify to t-/c-; Greek single s kept, but z/x>s
all roots, from either parent, take Goidelic lenition and the broad-slender contrast: medial b/m>bh/v, c>ch, t>th, d>dh where slender; long marks dropped in data
very short Greek roots take a Goidelic -an/-a closing; Greek -polis as a bound element softens to -bal (lenited baile) in coinages
fusion_rules.source_tilt: sea/coast/land-terrain, civic/polis, material and staple words from Greek roots (the Hellenic substrate works the harbours, the poleis, the fields and the trades: thalassa>talas, polis>balas, sitos>siot, argyros>airgir); kin-line/quality/abstract/rule/war words from Goidelic roots (the ruling cland register: mor, sean, dubh, ri, sluag); every chosen root then run through the one Goidelic-shaped sound-law so the seam is inaudible

lexicon._note: Single fused tongue derived via phonology.fusion_rules (gdd-hybrid-conlang-fusion.md): Greek sea/civic/material/staple roots + Goidelic kin/quality/rule/war roots, all run through one Goidelic-shaped sound-law (lenition, broad-slender, root-initial stress, Greek endings adapted); portmanteaus mark the blended institutions and bloodline. One word per concept, no slashes.

morphology.patronymic_form: the Goidelic ruling stock carry the Mac- (son of) / Ua- (descendant of) patronymic and the fine/cland lineage-name (the war-cland of the ri); the Hellenic populace keep the -ides / -ades patronymic and the polis/deme demonym of origin; the throne fuses both - a ri who also bears an archon-seat and a polis-title.
morphology.compounding_rule: Goidelic compounds ([fort-type|quality|saint](stem) + element: Dun-derg, red-fort; Ard-mor, great-height) layered over Hellenic civic compounds (feature/quality + -polis / linking -o-: Neapolis, Melanoros): the capital Galanpolis (the Gauls' city), Dun-Toran (Toran's-fort), Toran-polis (Toran's-city).

title_ladder.government: feudal (a Goidelic war-aristocracy over the Hellenic poleis: the ri and his flaith-kin at the crown, the tigerna-lords and the archon-governors over the city-provinces, the sworn hosting of the cland bound to the throne; the archons and the strategoi of the fleets, the agora and the philosophers' schools serve beneath)
title_ladder._tiers_note: Goidelic ladder, ascending, with the Hellenic substrate co-titles beneath. Tigerna (lord) barony over a Tigernas; Flaith-criche (lord of the border) march over a Crich (the border-land); Flaith (noble lord) county over a Flaithes; Toisech (chief / war-leader) duchy over a Toiseces; Ri-tuaithe (king of a tuath) principality over a Tuath (the petty kingdom); Ruiri (over-king) kingdom over a Ruirecht; Ard-ri (high king) empire over an Ard-rige (the high-kingship). The conquered poleis keep their Hellenic archon (city-magistrate) and strategos (general / fleet-commander) beneath the Celtic crown - the county ruler is displayed by the archon's title. The brithem (judge) and the fili/ollam (poet-sage), and the Hellenic hierophant, stand outside the ladder. Rank titles fuse the real Gaelic and Greek registers (allowed).
title_ladder.heir: Tanaiste (the designated heir; the Hellenic Diadochos for the polis-line)
title_ladder.display_policy: Ruler/domain titles shown in setting-gen, domain lists and vassal trees are ENGLISH (or an approved commonly-known foreign term where set in 'ruler'). The *_native conlang forms are for NPC DIALOGUE ONLY, never for structural/UI displays.

people_name_convention.order: the Goidelic ruling stock carry a personal name + Mac- / Ua- patronymic and a fine/cland lineage; the Hellenic populace carry a personal name + -ides patronymic + polis/deme demonym; order given-first.
people_name_convention.dual_register: the Goidelic war-aristocracy keep Gaelic names (the -an/-ach stems with Mac-/Ua- patronymics and a cland lineage); the Hellenic city-folk keep Greek names (the -on/-os/-eus stems with -ides patronymics and deme demonyms).
people_name_convention.theophoric: Celtic devotional on the morphed god-reflexes (Toran-mac, Mael-Orlann 'devotee of Orlann'); Hellenic devotional on the morphed stems (Tulrio-, Orlandro-, Numeno-): Tulriodoros (gift of Tulrios), Orlandrokles.

religion._note: Deity-names are morphs of the Agrippan canon - Celtic GOIDELIC reflexes PRIMARY (family_celtic theonym_set), Hellenic variants SECONDARY (the Hellenic deity-morphs in achillean's register), never real Celtic/Greek gods. Alignment PROVISIONAL: the Celtic war-oath and the cland's hosting meet the Hellenic civic law and the polis' settled order.
religion.the_one: Eternan (Celtic; Hellenic Aiternos) - the distant Ancient One, honored not petitioned

sample_deity_renames.Tulrius: Toran (Hell. Tulrios) - the sun, fire, and justice
sample_deity_renames.Gaiandus: Gaian (Hell. Gaiandros) - the enduring earth, cold, endurance
sample_deity_renames.Realta: Realtan (Hell. Realtia) - the mother, mercy, healing

worship_by_alignment.Lawful: venerates the Lawful powers - Eternan, Toran the just, Orlann of the sworn war, Realtan the merciful - and names the Chaotic powers fuath (spectres) / daimones, warded and unworshipped; the cland-oath and the polis' civic law bind alike, the sworn hosting and the ordered polis the social ideal
worship_by_alignment.Neutral: the ancestral war-dead (the deified ri and the heroes of the ruling cland) and the city-heroes of the poleis (the heroon-dead); the great powers invoked at the nemed-grove and the polis-temple situationally rather than worshipped wholesale
worship_by_alignment.Chaotic: Venerates the Chaotic powers of the canon, and names the Lawful powers - and Eternan - as the tyrant-gods to be defied.

religion.demon_epithet_pattern: the Chaotic powers, warded as fuath (Celtic spectres) or -daimon (Hellenic demon), keep their morphs + an epithet: Maraxus -> Maragan the War-Brand (Hell. Maraxos the Tyrant-Flame); Vacidus -> Faicid the Unmaker (Hell. Vakidos-daimon); Lusanto -> Losand the Hoard-Worm (Hell. Lusandos the Drowner-of-Gold).
religion.religious_orders_pattern: the Nemed (Celtic sacred grove) or Hieron / Temenos (Hellenic sacred precinct) of [power]: 'the Nemed of Toran', 'the Temenos of Tulrios'.
religion.saints_pattern: the deified ri and the heroes of the ruling cland (the war-dead honored at the cairn / the dun), and the Hellenic heroes (Heros [name], venerated at a heroon / tomb-shrine in the poleis).

holy_symbol_motifs.Toran: a sun-wheel over a crossed spear and scales
holy_symbol_motifs.Orlann: an iron spear crossed with an oath-ring
holy_symbol_motifs.Gaian: the standing stones above the olive-terrace

banks_patterns.ships: the war-curach and the long-keel, named in Celtic kennings and Hellenic virtue-names: 'the Wave-Hound', 'Raven of Galanpolis', 'the Nike', 'Pride of the Muir'
banks_patterns.military_units: the ri's sluagh (the sworn hosting / war-band) and the polis levies: 'the Sluagh of Galanpolis', 'the Spear-cland', 'the Bronze Phalanx of the poleis'
banks_patterns.taverns: 'The [Adjective] [Noun]': 'The Amber Kylix', 'The Spear and Olive', 'The Golden Curach'
banks_patterns.dungeons_ruins: sunken poleis and fallen Celtic duns: 'the Akropolis of [name]', 'the Sunken Nemed', 'the Cairn of the Ri', 'the broken Dun-rath'

Neapolis (the new polis of the substrate)
Akropolis-cairn (the citadel over the old cairn)
